TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A pastel courtroom sketch depicting a criminal trial scene. In the left foreground, a man with distinctive swept-back white-blond hair and a navy suit leans back holding up a black book with red lettering. At center, a gray-haired man in a dark suit and open-collared white shirt holds up a second black book, looking toward a woman standing at right in profile, who has long brown hair, hoop earrings, and a bright blue blazer. An older white-haired man with glasses, appearing to be a judge, watches from a raised bench at upper left. The background contains loosely sketched onlookers, a figure in a yellow garment, and an American flag on a pole. The composition reads as an artist's rendering of Michael Cohen testifying while defense counsel or the defendant displays his books.
TEXT: DISLOYAL
MICHAEL COHEN
REVENGE
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A single red-orange raffle ticket with scalloped, notched ends photographed against a white background. A large black smiley face — two dot eyes and a wide curved grin inside a bold circle — dominates the center. The word SMILE runs vertically to the left of the face, and the serial number 778548 runs vertically down both the left and right edges of the ticket. Along the bottom edge in small italic black capitals is the manufacturer line.
TEXT: SMILE
778548
778548
INDIANA TICKET CO.
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A photograph of Donald Trump outdoors against a dark, blurred green background. He wears a navy suit, white dress shirt, and a long bright red tie, with a small American flag pin on his left lapel and a white cufflink showing at his extended wrist. His head is tilted slightly with a tightened, serious expression, and he points his index finger directly toward the viewer in the foreground. The image has rounded corner cropping with a white border at the bottom edge.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A close-up, desaturated street photograph with selective color, showing a pedestrian crossing signal mounted on a galvanized metal pole. The signal's only lit lens glows green, displaying the LED walking-person symbol mid-stride, while the surrounding scene — a second signal head above, clusters of unlit vehicle traffic lights to the right, and pale overcast sky — is rendered in black and white. Mounting brackets, cables, and metal bands around the poles are visible below the signal.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A digitally composited nightscape: a snow-dusted mountain range with a sharp central summit rises in silhouette beneath a star-dense sky crossed diagonally by the glowing pink-and-blue band of the Milky Way. Planted on the central peak is a purple or magenta flag on a dark pole, its cloth bearing a small yellow castle emblem. A comet with a reddish-glowing head and white tail streaks down from the upper right, and a dark crescent moon or planet hangs in the top right corner, with a faint red glow along the horizon at right.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: The aftermath of a smash-in: a full-height glass door with a black frame hangs torn off its pivot, sagging diagonally outward from the doorway, its pane webbed completely with impact cracks and starred shatter points. The adjacent sidelight glass panels are likewise shattered and holed. Broken glass and debris carpet the floor and threshold, and the interior beyond — pale walls, a partial view of a room and plumbing fixtures — is bathed in saturated blue light with a strong red wash falling across the frame and floor, as from emergency or night lighting.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: door

TYPE: screenshot
SUBJECT: A nearly all-black frame, apparently captured from a video or presentation, with the lowercase white text "labac l" centered in a plain sans-serif font. A faint dark rounded shape is barely discernible along the top edge of the otherwise empty black field, with a dim greenish smudge at the top left corner. No other imagery is present.
TEXT: labac l

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A close-up crop of a digitally composited night scene: a magenta-purple rectangular flag flies from a thin dark pole, its field carrying a flat yellow castle emblem with three crenellated towers, small blue windows, and a blue arched doorway at center. Behind it spreads a starry sky, with the pinkish glow of the Milky Way toward the lower left, and a snow-covered rock summit juts into the bottom of the frame where the pole is planted. The flag image appears pasted over the photographic sky.

SUBJECT: A video still showing a white plaster cast of a classical female head with curled waves of hair across the brow, photographed in soft gray studio light. A banded snake in bright red-orange with black and pale cream rings is draped over the sculpture: its head reaches down toward the statue's forehead between the brows, its body loops across the crown of the head, and the tail section hangs down past the ear and neck. A rounded 0:08 duration badge sits in the lower left corner of the frame.
